digest.component_or_area: compact snapshot stripping and attestations migration
propositions: The emit_legacy_signature_mirror configuration field must be removed from CompactConfig schema and parser to hardcode never-persist behavior for the signature mirror in new snapshots.

The in-memory signature mirror re-derivation path (process_signature and most_recent_attestation fallback) must be preserved unchanged to maintain backward compatibility for readers on current binaries.
Removal is a one-way door: after landing, external projects on pre-attestations rebar cannot recover if they read a mirror-less snapshot with compacted signatures, except by code downgrade.
The readiness gate assertion must hold before landing: no pre-attestations rebar binary is active in this fleet to guard against broken readers after removal.
